Bill.BriefDescription: Streamlining and simplifying alcohol permits and licenses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the streamlining and simplification of permitsand licenses related to alcoholic beverages, such as beer, wine, andspirits; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that the processfor obtaining alcoholic beverages related permits and licenses isadministratively complex and unnecessarily confusing to applicants,licensees, members of the business community, and the public. (2) By December 30, 2014, and in compliance with RCW 43.01.036, theliquor control board must submit recommendations to appropriatecommittees of the legislature that detail the statutory changes andtechnology upgrades necessary to measurably streamline and simplify thealcoholic beverage licensing process. The liquor control board mustconvene a work group with representation from regulated parties toprovide input to and as the basis for the recommendations submitted. (3) The recommendations may include, but are not limited to:Applications for permits and licenses, renewals, appeals of agency p. 1 SB 6222adverse actions, penalties, and categories of permits and licenses.
